items.title: Ask AWS FinOps Agent resource-level cost questions with AWS Billing and Cost Management Data Hub (preview)
items.summary: Your teams ask resource-level cost questions every month: which resources drove last month's cost increase, which team owns those resources, and how the total ties to the invoice. To answer these questions, you can now use AWS Billing and Cost Management Data Hub, in public preview, with AWS FinOps Agent and ask your questions in plain language. Another way to answer these questions is to export your cost and usage data and build your own pipeline to query the export. With Data Hub, you can use a managed data layer that AWS FinOps Agent queries with SQL on your behalf. AWS provisions the data, refreshes the data, and maintains the schema for you, so you can start asking resource-level questions as soon as your dataset is ready.
items.creator: Sai Pydiganta
